blurb: Celebrity Farms breeds, raises, and races harness racing horses, including trotters and pacers. They have produced award-winning and record-setting horses competing at high levels. The farm is located on 125 acres near Goshen, NY, and is involved in major harness racing events such as the Hambletonian.
